sub_graphs.title: EIP-649: Difficulty Bomb Delay Mechanism
sub_graphs.description: Models the difficulty calculation with fake block number to delay ice age

nodes.label: Block Difficulty Calculation Initiated
nodes.description: System needs to calculate difficulty for a new block

nodes.label: Check if Byzantium Fork Active
nodes.description: Determine if block_number >= BYZANTIUM_FORK_BLKNUM

nodes.label: Pre-Byzantium Rules
nodes.description: Use original difficulty calculation (no delay)

nodes.label: Post-Byzantium Rules
nodes.description: Apply difficulty bomb delay

nodes.label: Compute Fake Block Number
nodes.description: fake_block = max(0, block_number - 3,000,000)

nodes.label: Compute Ice Age Component
nodes.description: Calculate 2^(fake_block // 100000 - 2) for exponential difficulty increase

nodes.label: Compute Final Difficulty
nodes.description: Combine parent difficulty adjustment with bomb component

nodes.label: Difficulty Computed
nodes.description: Block difficulty has been calculated with delayed bomb

external_entities.name: Parent Block
external_entities.description: The previous block providing baseline difficulty and timestamp

sub_graphs.title: EIP-649: Block Reward Reduction
sub_graphs.description: Models the reduction of block reward from 5 ETH to 3 ETH

nodes.label: Block Finalized
nodes.description: Block has been successfully mined and validated

nodes.label: Check Applicable Reward Rules
nodes.description: Determine if Byzantium reward reduction applies

nodes.label: Old Reward Rules (5 ETH)
nodes.description: Pre-Byzantium: base reward is 5 ETH

nodes.label: New Reward Rules (3 ETH)
nodes.description: Post-Byzantium: base reward is 3 ETH (3e18 wei)

nodes.label: Compute Miner Base Reward
nodes.description: Set miner reward to 3 ETH for post-Byzantium blocks

nodes.label: Compute Uncle Inclusion Rewards
nodes.description: Uncle reward = (8-k) * 3 ETH / 8, nephew reward = 3 ETH / 32

nodes.label: Credit Coinbase Account
nodes.description: Add computed rewards to miner's account balance

nodes.label: Rewards Distributed
nodes.description: Block and uncle rewards have been credited

external_entities.name: Block Miner
external_entities.description: Miner who successfully produced the block

sub_graphs.title: EIP-649: Difficulty Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation of block difficulty against expected value

nodes.label: Block Received for Validation
nodes.description: A new block has been received with a claimed difficulty

nodes.label: Compute Expected Difficulty
nodes.description: Calculate what the difficulty should be using EIP-649 rules

nodes.label: Compare Claimed vs Expected
nodes.description: Verify block.difficulty matches computed expected difficulty

nodes.label: Difficulty Valid
nodes.description: Block difficulty matches expected value

nodes.label: Difficulty Invalid
nodes.description: Block difficulty does not match - block rejected

ambiguities.text: The exact value of BYZANTIUM_FORK_BLKNUM is not specified in this EIP - it references a separate configuration.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BYZANTIUM_FORK_BLKNUM is defined in network configuration (4,370,000 for mainnet). This EIP defines the rule change, not the activation block.

ambiguities.text: The '1.4 years' delay estimation is mentioned but the exact calculation basis is not detailed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the estimation is based on average 15-second block times and the 3,000,000 block offset, yielding approximately 520 days of delay.

implicit_assumptions.description: The difficulty bomb delay provides sufficient time for Casper proof-of-stake development and deployment.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If PoS is not ready when the delayed bomb activates, another delay EIP will be needed, or block times will increase significantly.

implicit_assumptions.description: The reduced block reward (5→3 ETH) maintains sufficient mining incentive for network security.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Miners may leave the network if profitability drops too much, reducing hashrate and security.

implicit_assumptions.description: All clients implement the difficulty calculation and reward changes identically.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Implementation differences could cause consensus failures between clients.
